title: Read the Address
setup: Every square has a name. Move a pawn to the square named c4.
hint: Find the c-file first, then count up from White's edge: rank 1, rank 2, rank 3, rank 4.
explanation:
## The Idea

Letter first, number second. The c-file is the third column from White's left, and rank 4 is the fourth row up from White's edge, so c4 is where they cross.

The pawn on c2 is the only one standing on that file, and on its first move a pawn may step two squares: {{c4}}. The pawn on b2 could reach b4, but b4 is a different address.
